title: Negative: reading an uninitialized variable raises a VariableSpaceException
description: Reading an uninitialized variable raises a VariableSpaceException. Any attempt by a job step to read a variable that has not been initialized in the variable space must raise a VariableSpaceException rather than returning null or an empty value silently.
notes: Extension negative fixture. Silent null returns for uninitialized variables hide bugs. The VariableSpaceException must be raised and propagated, causing the job to reach FAILED.
